seo.meta_description: Curogram bundles HIPAA texting, telehealth, scheduling, forms, and payments for clinics. Starts $125/month. SOC 2 certified. Strong EHR integrations.

faqs.a: All-in-one patient communication platform: HIPAA-compliant two-way texting, video telehealth, online self-scheduling, digital intake forms, payment collection via text, appointment reminders, and automated review requests. Designed to reduce phone calls and no-shows.
Starts around $125/month with tiered pricing per provider or location. Custom quotes for larger practices. Pay-for-what-you-use model lets you start with core features and add more as needed.
Yes. HIPAA compliant with BAA provided. Also SOC 2 Type 2 certified, which is a strong security credential beyond basic HIPAA compliance.

faqs.q: Does Curogram work with my EHR?
faqs.a: Likely yes. Curogram advertises near-universal EHR support with native integrations. They sync with most practice management systems, which reduces duplicate data entry.

faqs.q: How does Curogram compare to Klara or OhMD?
faqs.a: All three are patient communication platforms with similar core features. Curogram emphasizes all-in-one bundling and claims faster staff training (10 minutes). Klara has stronger brand recognition. OhMD has more AI automation features. Curogram often wins on price for small practices.

faqs.q: Is Curogram good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Yes. They specifically market to mental and behavioral health clinics. The platform handles intake forms, appointment reminders, and HIPAA texting that therapy practices need. Not mental-health-specific, but well-suited for it.
